name: University of Sheffield International College

programs.title: Business, Social Sciences and Humanities
programs.summary: Study the Business, Social Sciences and Humanities pathway programme to gain the academic skills needed to succeed in a degree at the University of Sheffield.

programs.title: Science and Engineering
programs.summary: Study the Science and Engineering pathway programme to gain the academic and practical skills needed to succeed in a degree at the University of Sheffield.

programs.title: Business, Social Sciences and Humanities
programs.summary: This route will prepare you for a taught postgraduate degree in the Faculty of Social Sciences, including the Management School and the School of Law.

programs.title: Science and Engineering
programs.summary: This route will prepare you for a taught postgraduate degree in the Faculty of Engineering or the Faculty of Science.

programs.title: Business Management and Accounting
programs.summary: This route will provide you the vital academic skills and fundamental knowledge in the dynamic fields of business management and accounting, preparing you to excel in your chosen undergraduate degree at the University of Sheffield.

programs.title: Economics
programs.summary: This route will equip you with the essential academic skills and core economic knowledge to ensure you are well prepared to succeed in your chosen undergraduate degree at the University of Sheffield.

programs.title: Psychology
programs.summary: Study this route to develop the academic knowledge and practical scientific skills needed to succeed in a psychology undergraduate degree at the University of Sheffield.

description: The University of Sheffield is in an ideal location. The campus is set around the city centre, with all departments just a short walking distance from each other, or a very short ride on the bus or tram.
